reviews.text:
If I had one word to describe it - HORRIBLE.
Service was non existent, food quality was garbage equivalent - soggy and wet patty and fries.
One burger was literally missing the patty, how is that even possible?!
Save yourself some time and go anywhere else, as I would prefer to eat dog food next time rather than eat food from this place. Absolutely gross

By far the worst restaurant in the USA. ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE SERVICE. It's such bad service that it's laughable. It starts from the top from the manager. She doesn't fit the mold of a manager. Cold shoulder, doesn't care, no empathy.
Let's talk about the food now. There's always something wrong with the order. Whether it's something missing or something is burnt or cold. Comes back to the service and management and training. If that ever happened anywhere else, you'd get free entre cards or something.
In summary, this place falls behind any other restaurant.
Horrible location, food wrong. Plan to wait and fight getting into the parking lot. Doesn't seem to stop anyone from coming even with all the poor reviews. I will not be back.
Food is always fine, but the wait times are unbelievable. In no world should it take 25 minutes to get through a drive thru. It's astounding how slow things move.
